question: To whom and under what test condition must a particular thing be given?
premises: A particular thing is marked as to be given.
It is to be given to one who has been previously accomplished.
That recipient must have been tested for one year.
inference: Transmission is restricted to a previously accomplished person who has passed a one-year test.
uncertainties: The nature of the thing to be given is not specified here.
plain_english: It is to be given to one who was previously accomplished and has been tested for one year.
